newsitem.title: JAPAN: June JGBs end up, cash JGB yield hits record low.
newsitem.headline: June JGBs end up, cash JGB yield hits record low.

text.p: The key June JGB contract ended higher on Tuesday in Tokyo, ignoring the release of strong economic data in the afternoon, while the cash JGB yield fell to a record low of 2.320 percent.
"The bottom line is the supply-demand balance in the (JGB) market is so good that nobody wants to lighten their portfolio weighting of JGBs," said an agricultural bank trader.

The bullish JGBs totally shrugged off strong machinery orders data for January as well as healthy corporate capital investment data for the October-December 1996 quarter. Traders said the data had already been discounted in the market.
